name: lw_7607
statement: (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = a^2 + b^2) : 1 + 2 * Real.sqrt (a + b) + (a - b) ≤ 4 / (a + b) + (4 + 2 * (b - a)) / Real.sqrt (a + b)
closed: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = a^2 + b^2), 1 + 2 * Real.sqrt (a + b) + (a - b) ≤ 4 / (a + b) + (4 + 2 * (b - a)) / Real.sqrt (a + b)
informal:
Let $a,b>0$ and $a+b=a^2+b^2$ . Prove that, 

 $$1+2\sqrt{a+b}+(a-b)\leq  rac{4}{a+b}+ rac{4+2(b-a)}{\sqrt{a+b}}$$

Equality holds when $a= rac{\sqrt[3]{2(3\sqrt{78}-4)}}{3}- rac{7\sqrt[3]{4}}{3\sqrt[3]{3\sqrt{78}-4}}+ rac{4}{3}, b= rac{\sqrt[3]{27-3\sqrt{78}}}{3}+ rac{\sqrt[3]{9+\sqrt{78}}}{\sqrt[3]{4}}-1$
